source: class Piece : NeoObject { public int Rank = 0; }
NeoVariant<Piece> Seven = new(initialize: () => new Piece { Rank = 7 });
@settings(folder: Rows) NeoLookupVariant<Piece, Row> ByRow = new(initialize: (row) => new Piece { Rank = row.Rank });
class Item { public virtual NeoVariant<Piece>? Placed = null; }
class LookupSelection { public NeoLookupVariant<Piece, Row>? Variant; }
